name: gate-g7
note: A gate row of renderer/shell/gate_d02.py: the steps before the repeat block set the views; the block runs for warm-up plus window seconds as quiet steps (d02_run.expand_repeat), and tools/perf/d02/gate_row.py times the last window seconds. No step follows the block, so the window holds only the row's views. B24 G7: Global on the 20 Hopf rings, Local's chain on the named cap, held for the window. Local's whole chain: the slice's shell at its limit, so Local draws its whole chain, set before the repeat block (LF2).
